articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Kettle Hill Block Association
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting. Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Carver Lane use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Dana Gilroy, Canal Park

body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Upper Commons.
